name: Kaiser Permanente Redwood City Medical Center High School Volunteer Program
what_you_do: You help patients, visitors and staff with friendly service at the hospital. Roles include office help, greeting and walking people where they need to go, and the front desk.
who_can_apply: High school students 16 years or older (the kp.org page says ages 16 to 17). Applications open only when shifts are available. One-year commitment.
deadline_text: Closed. On 2026-10-16 the page said: not accepting applications, check back in 2027. No 2027 date is posted.
how_to_apply: When it opens again, sign up on the Kaiser volunteer site under Redwood City. You need one or two references from a teacher, coach or tutor. Then you do a video interview. Next is a health check where you bring your shot records. A parent must come. Last are online trainings and an in person orientation. Phone: 650-299-3135.
notes: Read on Kaiser's volunteer site and the kp.org Redwood City page on 2026-10-16. The two pages do not agree. kp.org says 4 hours a week for 6 months. The volunteer site says one year for high school students. Plan on one year. Kaiser does not offer job shadowing. The kp.org page also lists roles like the ER, art, pet visits and surgery. These differ by site.
